# Validation against the SNMMI Dosimetry Challenge

radot doses are computed on the clinical images of the [SNMMI 177Lu Dosimetry Challenge](https://doi.org/10.2967/jnumed.122.265094) and compared with the results of the challenge participants.

**There is no ground truth**: the reference is the distribution of the participants' results (median, interquartile range IQR, quartile coefficient of dispersion QCD = (Q3 − Q1) / (Q3 + Q1)), from Brosch-Lenz et al., J Nucl Med 2023;64:1109, Supplemental Table 1. This is complementary to the [validation against Monte Carlo](7_validation_opengate.md): OpenGATE checks the physics with a known activity, the challenge checks the workflow on real images against the community.

## The challenge

Two patients treated with ¹⁷⁷Lu-DOTATATE, imaged with SPECT/CT at 4 time points (Siemens Intevo, xSPECT Quant, images in Bq/mL).

| Patient | Sex | Injected (MBq) | Imaging days | Organs | Lesions |
|---|---|--:|---|---|--:|
| A | male | 7210 | 0, 1, 4, 5 | liver, ltkidney, rtkidney, spleen | 2 |
| B | female | 7305 | 0, 1, 4, 8 | liver, ltkidney, rtkidney | 4 |

Tasks:

| Task | Input | Left to the participant | radot |
|---|---|---|---|
| T1 | serial SPECT/CT | segmentation, registration, fit, dose | not yet |
| T2, T3 | planar (+ 1 SPECT/CT) | everything | out of scope |
| T4 | serial SPECT/CT + VOIs at each time point | time integration, dose | not yet |
| T5 | time-integrated activity (TIA) map + VOIs | dose only | below |

## T5: dose from the TIA map

- **Input**: the TIA map provided by the challenge (Bq·s/mL, registered to the first SPECT, unit `bqsml` in the sidecar) and the organ and lesion VOIs of the first time point.
- **Mass**: from the CT of the first time point resampled to the TIA grid (density from the Hounsfield units).
- **`svalue`**: TIA in the VOI × OpenDose self S-value, scaled to the VOI mass (ICRP-110 male phantom for A, female for B). Organs only: there are no S-values for lesions.
- **`ldm`**: local energy deposition of the voxel TIA, mean in the VOI.
- **`gate`**: [OpenGATE](https://github.com/OpenGATE/opengate) Monte Carlo (`opengate_dose_rate`, Lu-177, electrons and photons) with the TIA map as source and the CT on the TIA grid; the dose-rate map is used with `radot dose --dose-rate-map` (dose = map × TIA / simulated activity). Includes the photon self- and cross-doses. GATE unc.: statistical uncertainty (one standard deviation) of the VOI mean.
- **Total kidney**: mass-weighted mean of the left and right kidney doses.
- **Difference**: (radot − participants' median) / median; ✗ when radot is outside the participants' interquartile range [Q1–Q3].

Absorbed doses in Gy for the whole treatment cycle (the TIA map is integrated over time).

Findings:

- All organs and lesions (except the liver of A, see below) are within 6.5 % of the participants' median; outside the IQR: A Lesion2 (gate), A Kidneys (total) (ldm), A Kidneys (total) (gate).
- **Liver of A**: the liver VOI contains lesion 1. The participants' spread (QCD 32 %, the largest of T5) matches two liver definitions: the VOI as given gives 2.39 Gy (median 2.25 Gy), the liver without the lesions 1.32 Gy (Q1 1.27 Gy). For B the lesions inside the liver are small.
- The doses of A are a few percent below the median, those of B close to it. The Monte Carlo (`gate`, with photons and cross-doses) is as low as `svalue`: the cause is not the dose model. Possible causes, not checked: the mass (CT density vs volume × 1.0 or 1.06 g/mL used by many participants), the VOI definition.
- `ldm` is 1–2 % below `svalue`: no photon self-dose.
- `gate` vs `ldm`: -2.0 to +4.2 %; `gate` vs `svalue` (organs): -1.6 to +0.6 %. The Monte Carlo adds the photons and the cross-doses, and transports the electrons beyond the voxel and the VOI boundary.

## What this validates

- The **dose step** on real images: TIA image as input, VOI masses from the CT, OpenDose S-values with mass scaling, local deposition, and an external Monte Carlo dose-rate map (`--dose-rate-map`).
- Agreement with the community: radot falls in the narrow spread of the T5 participants (QCD 3–7 % for these targets).

## What this does not validate

- **Time integration** (T4) and **segmentation** (T1): not yet done.
- **Accuracy**: the participants' median is not a ground truth; a common bias of the participants and radot would not be seen.
- **Lesion doses with S-value methods**: no S-values for lesions.

## Data and how to run

The images and VOIs are from the University of Michigan [Deep Blue collection](https://deepblue.lib.umich.edu/data/collections/hm50ts030) (CC BY-NC 4.0, research only). They are not redistributed: download the zips by hand, see [`validation/snmmi/`](https://github.com/dsarrut/radot/tree/main/validation/snmmi).

> We acknowledge Yuni Dewaraja at the University of Michigan for providing access to Lu-177 patient imaging data and segmentations obtained with support from R01EB022075 awarded by NIBIB and R01CA240706 awarded by NCI, NIH. Data were shared via the University of Michigan Deep Blue Data sharing repository.

```bash
python validation/snmmi/prepare_data.py    # extract the zips and convert to NIfTI
python validation/snmmi/run_gate.py        # optional: OpenGATE dose-rate maps (needs opengate)
python validation/snmmi/t5.py              # T5 doses, writes results/t5_radot.json
pytest validation/snmmi                    # tests (T5 skipped without the data)
python validation/snmmi/report.py          # regenerate this page
```
